text:
Maria P.: heads-up — sketch for a Console "Insights shortcuts" feature: quick way to pin per-route / per-model views and save query templates. Need product + eng thoughts. cc @Saurabh @Jake

Jake H.: love it. q1: saved template vs pinned view? q2: sharing/permissions model?

Saurabh: infra perspective — saved template should be server-side (so cross-device). pinned view can be local. main concern: explosion of templates. we need tags + owner + team/org scope + soft-delete.

Anya: +1. also want ability to attach a routing policy snapshot and model version to a template so it's reproducible for rollouts/bug reproduction.

Kevin L.: this'll help SLO debugging. UX idea: star icon to pin, 'save as template' in the kebab menu. default columns/time-range should be part of template.

Maria P.: rough backend idea: resource `insight_template` with fields `id`, `owner_id`, `scope`, `tags`, `payload`(filters/columns/time_range), `model_snapshot`(optional). payload versioned.

Saurabh: backend ok. store payload as JSON blob string, but keep a small indexed subset for search (name, tags, owner, scope). retention policy required (e.g., 1y default). pagination + listing rate limits if org has many.

Console Bot: design doc uploaded — https://redwood.company/docs/insights-shortcuts v1 (PR 482). awaiting reviews :eyes:

Jake H.: for sharing model I propose: default private, org-visible opt-in, share link -> token-based read-only. no auto-public.

Anya: also prompt users after they customize columns: 'Save changes as template?' and include a small preview modal.

Maria P.: action items: @Jake prototype frontend interactions, @Saurabh propose backend schema + retention and list API, @Anya mock copy & flows. sync Thurs 10:00am PT. :calendar:

Kevin L.: i'll add telemetry events: `template_created`, `template_applied`, `template_shared`, `template_deleted`, plus counts + last_used_ts.

Console Bot: thread archived by Console Bot.
